fields.question_text: What is the time complexity of searching for an element in a balanced binary search tree?
fields.reference_answer: In a balanced BST, the height is log(n), so binary search operations take O(log n).

fields.question_text: Explain the concept of immutability in functional programming.
fields.reference_answer: Immutability means data cannot be changed after it's created. Instead, new copies are made with modified data.
